title: Verification path map (verify.yml)
description: Which rung of the verification ladder covers which paths (SecOps plan Step 39, issue #132). Every verify-*.yml reads this file; a high-risk path with no rung is a finding in all of them. Absent, workflows fall back to the HIGH_RISK_GLOBS list. Guide: docs/verification.md.

high_risk_globs.description: Replaces the built-in HIGH_RISK_GLOBS fallback for paths not listed below.

glob.description: Gitignore-style glob (** spans directories) relative to the repository root.

risk.description: high: every rung listed must report; a changed high-risk path with no rung blocks at Standard. low: boundary contracts only.

rungs.description: Ladder rungs expected on this path, lowest first.

tool.description: Which verify-*.yml owns the path; inferred from the file extension when absent.

targets.description: dafny: compile targets whose generated code is drift-checked (#128).

covers.description: tla, alloy, lean: implementation globs the model stands for; a change under them without a model change is reported (#130, #131).

budget.description: Per-path overrides of the brief's budgets (CrossHair 3/45 s, fuzz 45s, Dafny 60 s).
